question: What does the WHO Pandemic Agreement adopted in May 2025 commit countries to?
text:
The agreement is a framework. Its commitments are broad, and it isn't yet open for signature.

**Status**
- The World Health Assembly adopted the agreement on 20 May 2025.[1]
- The Pathogen Access and Benefit Sharing (PABS) annex is an integral part of the agreement. States can sign only after the annex is negotiated and adopted by a later World Health Assembly.[2]
- Member States have reaffirmed that they aim to finalize the annex for the Assembly's consideration in May 2027.[3]
- Once open for ratification, the agreement enters into force 30 days after 60 countries have ratified it.[1]

**Main commitments**
- **General framework:** The agreement sets out a framework to help countries prevent, prepare for and respond to future pandemics. It rests on equity, solidarity and respect for national sovereignty.[1]
- **Pathogen sharing and benefit sharing (PABS):** The PABS annex would set up a system for rapid, transparent sharing of pathogens with pandemic potential and their genetic sequence data. It would also ensure rapid and equitable access to the resulting vaccines, diagnostics and therapeutics.[3] The annex is still being negotiated, so the details of this core obligation are not settled.
- **Financing:** The agreement establishes a Coordinating Financial Mechanism to support pandemic prevention, preparedness and response capacities in countries.[1]
- **National implementation:** Each country is responsible for integrating the agreement's goals into its national plans and policies.[1]

From my own knowledge of the text, which I didn't check in these search results, the agreement also covers:
- strengthening surveillance and a "One Health" approach to prevention;
- supporting research and development;
- expanding geographically diverse production of health products;
- promoting technology transfer and know-how sharing on mutually agreed terms;
- building resilient supply chains and a global logistics network.

**Sovereignty safeguards**
- The agreement states that it gives WHO no authority to impose measures such as lockdowns or vaccine mandates on any country.[1]
- Nothing in it lets WHO change or interfere with national laws.[4]

**Adoption**
- The main text was adopted by a vote. Eleven countries abstained and 46 were absent.[2]

The full text and the negotiation updates are on WHO's Pandemic Agreement page.

Sources:
[1] https://www.who.int/health-topics/pandemic-agreement
[2] https://www.twn.my/title2/health.info/2025/hi250505.htm
[3] https://www.who.int/news/item/13-11-2026-member-states-reiterate-commitment-to-finalize-pandemic-agreement-pabs-annex-by-may-2027
[4] https://news.un.org/en/story/2025/05/1163451
